svg.title: The author's flute, fingers-A4, sheet 1 of 1
svg.desc: 1 user unit = 1mm. The author's 2017 flute, redrawn: fingers-A4, sheet 1 of 1: block layer, bottom plate, mouthpiece cap, plug disc, side wall, top plate. 3mm ply, drawn for a 0.13mm kerf. Blue #0000ff engraves: the part numbers, the flue as a fill engrave about 1mm deep over the plug, and the depression round each finger hole, a greyscale image engrave to set to depth on scrap. File the window's far edge to a bevel by hand. Orange #ff8000 cuts the holes and the window, black #000000 frees the parts.
